# a11y.hidden-focusable — Focusable element is inside aria-hidden content

- **Check ID:** `a11y.hidden-focusable`
- **Default severity:** `error`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** WCAG 4.1.2, WCAG 2.4.3
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/a11y.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/a11y.hidden-focusable.md`](../a11y.hidden-focusable.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

An element with `aria-hidden="true"` is, or contains, something the keyboard can still focus.

## Why it matters

`aria-hidden="true"` removes content from what screen readers announce, but it does not stop keyboard focus. A keyboard or screen reader user who tabs into hidden content lands on a link or button that has no name and no role in the accessibility tree: focus seems to vanish, or an unlabeled control is announced. This is a common bug in carousels, off-screen menus, modals that are closed, and decorative icons that were made clickable.

## What it checks

Every `aria-hidden="true"` element (outermost only) that is itself focusable or contains something focusable: links with `href`, enabled buttons, inputs other than `type="hidden"`, selects, textareas, `summary`, `contenteditable` regions, and any element with `tabindex` of 0 or more. Elements with `tabindex="-1"` are accepted, because keyboard users do not reach them by Tab. Content inside an element with the `hidden` or `inert` attribute is skipped, because no one can reach it.

## How to fix

```html
<!-- before: the link is announced to no one but still takes focus -->
<div class="menu" aria-hidden="true"><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></div>

<!-- after: hide it from everyone while it is closed -->
<div class="menu" hidden><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></div>
```

If the content should be used, remove `aria-hidden`. If it should be hidden, hide it for everyone with `hidden` or `inert`, or with CSS `display: none` or `visibility: hidden`. For a decorative icon that is also a control, put the label on the control and `aria-hidden` on the icon only. There is no automatic edit, because the right fix depends on whether the content should be reachable.

## Options

None.
